items.reason: Repeats the rejected claim that getCalendarCredentials exposes an unawaited calendar Promise that callers use as a Calendar. The alleged alternative callers are the same consumer-handling concern covered by #03.

Identifies the same unawaited getCalendar call in getCalendarCredentials and proposes the same async propagation. This matches #03, which establishes that consumers go through getConnectedCalendars and await the calendar.
